description: Substantiated JLCPCB process limits. A value belongs here only if it
carries its provenance: an authoritative source, a URL or document
identifier, a retrieval or effective date, units, the service or process
it applies to, and any conditions or exceptions.
A value is NEVER promoted here because one board happens to use it. If it
cannot be substantiated it is classified instead as configurable toolkit
policy, a selected board constraint, a conservative design target, or a
board waiver - and it stays with the board.
Nothing here is fetched at validation time. These are frozen figures with
recorded retrieval dates; re-checking them against the manufacturer is a
deliberate, reviewed act, not something a release does on its own.

plugged_via_to_mask_opening_mm.name: JLCPCB ordinary ink via plugging (tented/plugged vias)
plugged_via_to_mask_opening_mm.rule: Minimum distance from a plugged via to an adjacent solder-mask opening (pad) so the ink dam is retained.
plugged_via_to_mask_opening_mm.applies_to: PCB fabrication, ordinary ink via plugging
plugged_via_to_mask_opening_mm.interpretation: Measured from the via annular-ring edge to the nearest solder-mask aperture edge, on the same board side. Vias whose annulus intersects an aperture cannot be plugged at all and are reported separately.
plugged_via_to_mask_opening_mm.exceptions: Does not apply to a filled-and-capped or resin-plugged process, which a board must order explicitly.

description: Figures inherited from a board's own tooling that are PLAUSIBLY
manufacturer-wide but for which no authoritative source has been
recorded. They are kept here, unused by any gate, so the work of
substantiating them is visible rather than forgotten.
Until each carries a source, a URL or document id, and a retrieval date,
it must be supplied by a board as its own constraint - not read from
here. Do not promote one to `limits` without that evidence.

component_body_spacing_by_package_pair_m.status: UNSUBSTANTIATED - do not use as a JLCPCB-wide requirement
component_body_spacing_by_package_pair_m.origin: PCB_MicrophoneArrayV2 tools/check_placement.py, commit 9ba07cf, where it is described only as 'JLCPCB recommended minimum body-to-body spacing, by package pair' with no citation
component_body_spacing_by_package_pair_m.what_would_substantiate_it: A JLCPCB assembly capability page or DFM document stating minimum component-to-component spacing, with a retrieval date. Until then a board that wants this check supplies the matrix in its own manifest.
